evidence_quotes: Boete op grond van de Meststoffenwet wegens overschrijding van de gebruiksnormen voor dierlijke meststoffen en stikstof.
rationale: The decision concerns an administrative fine under the Dutch Fertilizers Act (Meststoffenwet) for exceeding application standards for animal manure and nitrogen, along with arguments regarding nitrogen volatilization corrections and flat-rate nitrogen/phosphate stock levels. Under the protocol rules, agricultural manure/nitrogen/phosphate regulation under the Meststoffenwet without water law or water governance adjudication is classified as NOT_WATER.
